verdict.rationale: Docs show a `hatchet worker dev` command for running a worker locally with hot-reload and `hatchet quickstart` for scaffolding a project, which partially covers 'run locally with one command,' but there is no evidence that this spins up the full engine (control plane + workers) in one command, nor any mention of testing utilities such as time-skipping or mocked-step unit-testing helpers. missing for 10: evidence of a single command that boots the entire engine (control plane, queue, workers) locally, and any documented testing/mocking framework or time-travel utilities for unit-testing workflows.
